notes.notes:
[b] Patch Notes[/b]
[list][*]The issue with only the 1st controller responding when multiple XInput controllers are plugged in has been resolved in this version update.[/list]

notes.title: Eschatos demo release & Hi Score challenge
notes.notes:
One of the best rated shooting games on Steam, Eschatos, 
now has a demo so there's no excuse for not checking out the game which 
one player described as [b]"a shmup that understands the joys of shmups"[/b] .

The demo features plenty to whet your appetite...
[list]
[*]Stage 1 (Areas 1-6) Original Mode
[*]Stage 4 (Areas 16-20) Advanced Mode
[/list]
... so when you're hungry for more, grab the game while it's on sale!

And if that's not enough, we also have a great contest for beginners and experts alike.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6058377/1d12dbf776df5320a8d47421d3f8eaaf5c74d783.png[/img]

[b]Dates:[/b] 9/01 (now!) ~ Sep 15th 10am PST
[b]Rules:[/b] During the contest top 3 scorers in the following modes will receive a prize, as will one random player from each leaderboard.
[i]NB: Valid scores must have a replay and be recorded during the contest.[/i]
[olist]
[*]Original Normal Mode
[*]Original Endless Mode
[/olist]
[b]Prizes:[/b] Top 3 scorers on each leaderboard will receive a Qute game or DLC of their choice (so you can even gift a friend Echatos!) or $5 Steam Wallet code. The 2 random winners will receive an Eschatos sticker set.

notes.title: ESCHATOS V1.1.1 Update Is Now Live! / V1.1.1 更新内容
notes.notes:
[b]Eschatos V1.1.1 Patch Details - 11/09/2015[/b]

This update adds several new settings intended to improve game performance, especially for users with choppy framerates.

[b][u]The options aren't enabled by default, so be sure to look in the options and enable these settings as needed![/u][/b]
[list][*]Added Options -> Screen Settings -> V-Sync toggle setting.[/list]
This option enables or disables vertical sync control.  Toggling this may reduce screen tearing or input lag for some users.
[list][*]Added Options -> Screen Settings -> Framerate Smoothing.[/list]
Turning this option on optimizes framerates for a smoother appearance, especially on lower-end hardware.  Turn this on if you are having problems with choppy framerate.
[list][*]Added Options -> System Settings - Texture Preload.[/list]
Turning this option on loads additional textures to the GPU VRAM before the game begins.  This creates a longer load time at the start of the game, but my reduce or eliminate load times between levels during the game, allowing a more seamless experience.  

You need to restart the game after enabling this option for it to take effect.
[list][*]Increased compatiblity for XInput and DirectInput controllers.
[*]Corrected an error where the BGM would skip/not play correctly.
[*]Additional tweaks to English menu localization.
[*]Added support for the upcoming Eschatos Arranged Soundtrack.[/list]

[h1]ESCHATOS Ver.1.1.1 アップデート[/h1]

[list]
[*] OPTIONS - SCREEN SETTINGS - [b]VSYNC WAIT[/b] 設定を追加。
[*] OPTIONS - SCREEN SETTINGS - [b]FRAMERATE CONTROL[/b] 設定を追加。
この設定を切り替えることでフレームレート低下が改善する場合があります。
[*] OPTIONS - SYSTEM SETTINGS - [b]TEXTURE PRELOAD[/b] 設定を追加。
ONにすると、ゲーム起動時に全てのテクスチャをロードし、ステージ開始時のロードが短くなります。その代わりにVRAM使用量が増加します。（反映には、ゲームの再起動が必要）
[*] PCに複数のDirectInputコントローラを差した場合に、どれか1つのコントローラでしか入力できない問題を修正。
[*] XInputコントローラーとDirectInputコントローラーが同時に繋がっていたとき、DirectInputコントローラーでボタン設定が変更できなかった問題を修正。
[*] 音楽の音飛びを改善。
[*] メニューの英語表記を一部修正。
[*] 後日リリース予定の Arranged Sound Track DLC に対応するための更新。
[/list]
